title: ArtELingo: A Million Emotion Annotations of WikiArt with Emphasis on Diversity over Language and Culture

bias_targets.methodology: Collecting human emotion annotations and captions for artworks across multiple languages (English, Arabic, Chinese, Spanish) to identify cross-cultural differences in emotional perception, and evaluating multilingual models on emotion prediction and affective caption generation to observe how cultural norms (e.g., varying reactions to nudity or religious symbols) impact model performance and outputs.

Analyzing the distribution of artists' nationalities within the base WikiArt dataset to quantify the overrepresentation of Western artworks compared to other regions such as the Middle East and East Asia.

Evaluating the performance drops and generalization capabilities of emotion prediction and caption generation models when trained on one language (or a mix) and tested on another, including zero-shot evaluations.
